claim: The tile and scale-layout changes (78014b4) change GEMM outputs only by float rounding.
method: scratch-free reproduction: gemm_gpu on fixed synthetic Q4_K and Q6_K weights (512 x 4096) and 148 tokens of activations, before (5835aff) and after (78014b4); then LLaDA-8B logits for an 84-token canvas.

llada_logits_84_tokens.note: The worst rows are prompt rows, which amplify rounding through 32 layers; masked rows, the ones a step samples, stay above 0.99994.
